meta.title: useTransition — isPending keeps the UI responsive

annotations.label: Memoized heavy list
annotations.detail: SlowList re-renders whenever its `filter` prop changes. In a real app this might be thousands of rows or a complex tree. React can interrupt and defer this work when it's inside a transition.

annotations.label: Component declaration
annotations.detail: Search keeps two pieces of state: inputValue (urgent — updated immediately so the input feels responsive) and deferredFilter (non-urgent — wrapped in startTransition so React can defer re-rendering SlowList while the user is still typing).

annotations.label: isPending = deferred work in flight
annotations.detail: isPending becomes true the moment startTransition fires and stays true until React commits all the renders scheduled inside the transition. Use it to show a loading indicator while the heavy update catches up.
